touchnmotion_ground_probe_direct.conversion: @Redirect of the `new ClipContext(from, to, COLLIDER, NONE, player)` and the Level.clip right after it in Stride.level and TerrainBalance.floor: inside the render frame (GameRenderer.render(DeltaTracker, boolean) HEAD/RETURN @Inject) on its thread, the constructor wrapper keeps the five values and yields INERT (a ClipContext made with CollisionContext.empty(): 1.21.1's Entity constructor has no null check), the clip wrapper walks the segment with vanilla's BlockGetter.traverseBlocks and a step of getBlockState, ClipContext.Block.COLLIDER's shape for one CollisionContext.of(player) per player, level and frame, and the level's clipWithInteractionOverride (the fluid read Fluid.NONE never uses is left out), with the same miss result. Steps aside (shipped probe, one WARN per level class) when the level's class chain declares its own clip other than vanilla_raycast_fluid_none's (bons.furious.mixin.vanilla_raycast.LevelClipMixin) or a getFluidState below Level, or another mod merged code into ClipContext or BlockGetter (Radium's world.raycast @Overwrite of BlockGetter.clip included). Runtime flag touchnmotionGroundProbeDirect (shadow .shadow). Helpers bons.furious.patch.touchnmotion_c49.TnmProbe, TnmFrame.

touchnmotion_pose_block_memo.conversion: @Redirect: the COLLIDER + Fluid.NONE probes of WallSurface.clip, SupportSearch.deck / find / clear / valid and WallSqueeze.crouchOffset go through touchnmotion_ground_probe_direct's direct probe (TnmProbe; nothing without that switch); the floor probes of a render frame (GameRenderer.render(DeltaTracker, boolean) HEAD @Inject marks the switch applied) read each block once into a per-frame, per-level memo (BlockPos.asLong -> state, collision shape for the collision context object it was made with, outline shape), cleared at frame end; TerrainBalance.floor's getBlockState of the hit block gets the probe's read and its fence / wall / gate getShape is made once per block and frame (@Redirect of both calls). Steps aside wherever the direct probe does (a level with another mod's clip, another mod's code merged into ClipContext or BlockGetter). Runtime flag touchnmotionPoseBlockMemo (shadow .shadow). Helpers bons.furious.patch.touchnmotion_c49.TnmMemo, TnmProbe, TnmFrame.
